product.name: Klaro
product.tagline: Instant plain-language medical document understanding and care coordination for the Philippines
product.overview: Klaro scans medical documents (lab results, prescriptions, discharge summaries), explains results in plain language, offers context-aware AI chat, shows nearby clinics and hospitals, and enables booking and payment for Filipino doctors. This PRD now contains epics, tickets, owners, acceptance criteria and testing guidance for both mobile and web delivery, plus a centralized backend API strategy shared by web and mobile.
targetAudience: Filipino patients who receive lab results, prescriptions, or discharge summaries
Caregivers and family members supporting elders
Doctors who want efficient intake and pre-read of patient documents
Clinics and hospitals seeking an integrated booking channel

implementationGuide.overview: Klaro is built as a mobile-first + web app using a monorepo (Expo for mobile, Next.js for web, centralized tRPC backend). This guide helps AI agents implement features in the correct order with minimal dependencies and keeps all clients on one typed backend contract.

architectureStack.llm: Prompt-based API (OpenAI or similar) with rule-based verification

apiPlatform.singleSourceOfTruth: packages/api owns all business endpoints, validation, auth guards, error envelopes, and service orchestration.
apiPlatform.clientAccess: apps/nextjs and apps/expo consume the same typed AppRouter through generated or shared clients.
boundaryRules: No direct database access from apps/*
No duplicate endpoint logic in web or mobile
All mutations and reads go through typed procedures
All request/response payloads use shared Zod schemas

implementationOrder.goal: Setup the centralized backend API, DB schema, and core services
implementationOrder.guide: Start backend and DB because mobile/web upload endpoints depend on it. Set up one shared API surface first, then connect every client to it before feature work expands.

implementationOrder.goal: Enable users to upload documents and extract text
implementationOrder.guide: Mobile and web upload UIs, then plug into OCR backend. Test with sample PDFs.

implementationOrder.goal: Generate plain-language explanations and chat support
implementationOrder.guide: Build LLM prompt templates and safety guards, then wire to frontend.

implementationOrder.goal: Show nearby clinics, enable doctor booking and payments
implementationOrder.guide: Parallel tracks: map (data ingest + UI) and doctor system (CRUD + booking). Payments last since it gates booking flow.

implementationOrder.goal: User accounts, history, security and observability
implementationOrder.guide: Auth and history optional for demo; security and monitoring for production readiness.

high.description: .env files contain production-grade credentials (Neon PostgreSQL password, Google Gemini API keys, Cal.com API key)
high.impact: Critical security vulnerability - credentials exposed in working directory
high.fix: Rotate all credentials immediately; add pre-commit hooks to block .env commits

high.title: API key exposed in URL query parameter
high.description: Gemini API key passed as URL query parameter in llm.ts line 542, gets logged in server access logs and browser history
high.impact: API key exposed in logs and browser history
high.fix: Move to x-goog-api-key header instead of URL parameter

high.title: Cloudinary API key leaked to client
high.description: Cloudinary API key returned in JSON response to client in sign/route.ts line 55
high.impact: API key exposed allowing unauthorized API calls
high.fix: Remove apiKey from response body; use server-side upload only

high.title: Wildcard CORS on sensitive endpoints
high.description: All API routes use Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * allowing any website to make requests
high.impact: CSRF attacks possible from any origin

high.title: Auth bypass in dev mode
high.description: protectedProcedure middleware bypasses authentication entirely in development mode (trpc.ts lines 126-129)
high.impact: All protected endpoints accessible without auth if isDev is true
high.fix: Remove or gate behind explicit dev-only flag that cannot be true in production

high.title: Cal.com API key embedded in URL
high.description: Cal.com API key passed as URL query parameter and returned to client in scheduling/create/route.ts line 53
high.impact: API key exposed in client-side code
high.fix: Make server-side API call instead of passing URL to frontend

high.title: Stripe webhook without real verification
high.description: handleWebhook is a public tRPC mutation that accepts client-supplied stripeSignature instead of verifying HMAC
high.impact: Webhook can be spoofed by attacker

high.title: Stripe client secret stored in database
high.description: stripeClientSecret stored in payments table (schema.ts line 238) - these are ephemeral and should never be persisted
high.impact: Payment session tokens exposed if database compromised

medium.title: In-memory rate limiter not shareable across instances
medium.description: Rate limit store is module-scoped plain object; doesn't work across serverless function invocations
medium.impact: Rate limit trivially bypassable in production
medium.fix: Use Redis or Vercel KV for distributed rate limiting

medium.title: Duplicate admin functions across routers
medium.description: isAdmin/requireAdmin functions duplicated in admin.ts and doctor.ts with different names

medium.title: Duplicate doctor router exports
medium.description: Every doctor endpoint exported twice under different names (camelCase alias and PascalCase)
medium.impact: Doubled API surface area and confusion

medium.title: FacilityTypeRank and FACILITY_TYPE_ORDER duplicated
medium.description: Same constant/function defined in 3 locations: facilities.ts router, facilities.ts service, and validators
medium.impact: Changes in one location won't propagate to others

medium.title: searchBySpecialty does not filter at DB level
medium.description: Fetches limit facilities from DB then filters in JavaScript instead of SQL
medium.fix: Move filter to SQL level using JSONB query

medium.title: Duplicate Zod schemas between validators and API
medium.description: medicalContextSchema and recommendByTestResultsSchema defined in both packages
medium.fix: Use schemas from validators package only

medium.title: assertSession throws raw Error with string comparison
medium.description: assertSession() throws Error('UNAUTHORIZED') and callers match on message string
medium.fix: Use custom error class or typed error code

medium.title: Dead code: unused export in validators
medium.description: export const unused = z.string().describe(...) exists as documentation only

medium.title: In-memory prompt version store resets on restart
medium.description: A/B testing prompt versions stored in module-level variables; lost on cold start
medium.impact: Loss of A/B testing metrics in production

medium.title: Excessive console.log in production
medium.description: 46 instances of console.log/warn/error throughout codebase without structured logging
medium.impact: Noisy logs and potential log injection
medium.fix: Introduce structured logger with log levels

medium.title: page.new.tsx dead file
medium.description: File named page.new.tsx sits alongside page.tsx in scan directory - Next.js ignores .new.tsx extension

medium.title: Inconsistent as any type casts
medium.description: 24 instances of as any across codebase bypassing TypeScript type safety

medium.title: Timing middleware adds artificial delays in dev
medium.description: Every tRPC request in dev mode has random 100-500ms delay added

low.title: Beta auth dependency
low.impact: Potential breaking changes and security issues in beta

low.title: Inconsistent Zod imports
low.description: Mix of zod/v4 subpath imports vs potential bare zod imports

low.title: analyzeScanBatch exported but never used
low.description: Function defined and exported but never imported anywhere
